frontmatter_raw:
type: Playbook
title: Alef Generated Bindings
description: "Edit Alef bindings: output paths, configuration, core regeneration and FFI JSON."
paths:
  - "alef.toml"
  - "packages/**"
  - "crates/xberg-ffi/**"
  - "crates/xberg-py/**"
  - "crates/xberg-node/**"
  - "crates/xberg-php/**"
  - "crates/xberg-jni/**"
  - "crates/xberg-wasm/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/extractors/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/plugins/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: alef-generated-bindings
  metadata:
    name: alef-generated-bindings

type: Playbook
title: Api Server Mcp
description: "Change REST routes, middleware, cache endpoints, server startup or MCP tools."
paths:
  - "crates/xberg/src/api/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/mcp/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/cache/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: api-server-mcp
  metadata:
    priority: critical
    name: api-server-mcp

type: Playbook
title: Benchmark Workflow
description: "Run extraction benchmarks; score quality and manage fixtures or ground truth."
paths:
  - "tools/benchmark-harness/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: benchmark-workflow
  metadata:
    name: benchmark-workflow

type: Playbook
title: Chunking Embeddings
description: "Change text chunking, embeddings or RAG configuration and code."
paths:
  - "crates/xberg/src/chunking/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/embeddings/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: chunking-embeddings
  metadata:
    priority: critical
    name: chunking-embeddings

type: Playbook
title: Config Loading Precedence
description: "Resolve config precedence: CLI, server/MCP, walk-up files, JSON and overrides."
paths:
  - "crates/xberg/src/core/config/**"
  - "crates/xberg-cli/src/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: config-loading-precedence
  metadata:
    name: config-loading-precedence

type: Playbook
title: Crate Structure
description: "Place code or crates: workspace members, versions, package paths and ignore rules."
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: crate-structure
  metadata:
    name: crate-structure

type: Playbook
title: E2E Fixtures
description: "Add or edit e2e fixtures: calls, inputs, mocks, assertions and schema."
paths:
  - "fixtures/**"
  - "e2e/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: e2e-fixtures
  metadata:
    name: e2e-fixtures

type: Playbook
title: Extraction Pipeline Patterns
description: "Change extraction orchestration: cache, fallback, processing and concurrency."
paths:
  - "crates/xberg/src/core/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/extraction/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/extractors/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/plugins/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: extraction-pipeline-patterns
  metadata:
    priority: critical
    name: extraction-pipeline-patterns

type: Playbook
title: Feature Flag Conventions
description: "Edit Cargo features: ORT-free targets, aggregates, PDF backends and parity."
paths:
  - "**/Cargo.toml"
  - "scripts/ci/check-feature-parity.py"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: feature-flag-conventions
  metadata:
    name: feature-flag-conventions

type: Playbook
title: Format Specific Extraction
description: "Add or change format extractors: parsers, archive budgets and metadata."
paths:
  - "crates/xberg/src/extractors/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/extraction/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: format-specific-extraction
  metadata:
    priority: high
    name: format-specific-extraction

type: Playbook
title: Mime Detection Routing
description: "MIME detection and routing for misrouted files or new formats."
paths:
  - "crates/xberg/src/core/mime.rs"
  - "crates/xberg/src/core/mime/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/extractors/mod.rs"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: mime-detection-routing
  metadata:
    name: mime-detection-routing

type: Playbook
title: Ocr Pipeline And Quality
description: "OCR backends, preprocessing, caches, hOCR, tables and quality comparisons."
paths:
  - "crates/xberg/src/ocr/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/paddle_ocr/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/sceptre_ocr/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/candle_ocr/**"
  - "crates/xberg-tesseract/**"
  - "crates/xberg-paddle-ocr/**"
  - "crates/xberg-candle-ocr/**"
  - "tools/ocr-measure/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: ocr-pipeline-and-quality
  metadata:
    name: ocr-pipeline-and-quality

type: Playbook
title: Pdf Backends
description: "Native/Pdfium selection, rendering, encryption and OCR fallback for PDF work."
paths:
  - "crates/xberg/src/pdf/**"
  - "crates/xberg/src/extractors/pdf/**"
  - "crates/xberg-native-pdf/**"
  - "crates/xberg-pdfium-render/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: pdf-backends
  metadata:
    name: pdf-backends

type: Playbook
title: Plugin Architecture Patterns
description: "Change plugin traits, typed registries, lifecycle or Alef Python bridges."
paths:
  - "crates/xberg/src/plugins/**"
  - "crates/xberg-py/src/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: plugin-architecture-patterns
  metadata:
    priority: critical
    name: plugin-architecture-patterns

type: Playbook
title: Polyrepo Boundaries
description: "Coordinate cross-repo fixes, API ownership and compatible sibling changes."
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: polyrepo-boundaries
  metadata:
    name: polyrepo-boundaries

type: Playbook
title: Test Corpus
description: "Fetch test_documents fixtures or use read_test_fixture and A/B corpus controls."
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: test-corpus
  metadata:
    name: test-corpus

type: Playbook
title: Wasm Constraints
description: "Diagnose wasm32 builds/runtime: feature limits, sync APIs and size constraints."
paths:
  - "crates/xberg-wasm/**"
  - "e2e/wasm/**"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: wasm-constraints
  metadata:
    name: wasm-constraints

type: Playbook
title: Xberg Release
description: "Prepare Xberg releases: version sync, generated bindings, chart and CI gates."
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: xberg-release
  metadata:
    name: xberg-release

type: Playbook
title: Xberg Typescript Toolchain
description: "Change TS/JS tooling: pnpm/npm locks, Vitest, napi-rs, wasm-pack and integrations."
paths:
  - "crates/xberg-node/**"
  - "crates/xberg-wasm/**"
  - "integrations/node/**"
  - "e2e/node/**"
  - "e2e/wasm/**"
  - "package.json"
  - "tsconfig.json"
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: xberg-typescript-toolchain
  metadata:
    name: xberg-typescript-toolchain

type: Playbook
title: Batch Extraction
description: Use when extracting from many files at once with shared config, bounded parallelism, per-file overrides, and error recovery. Covers the `batch` command, `--file-configs`, `--max-concurrent`, and output layout.
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: xberg-batch-extraction
  metadata:
    name: xberg-batch-extraction

type: Playbook
title: Chunking
description: Use when splitting extracted text into chunks for LLM context windows or RAG ingestion. Covers chunk size, overlap, markdown/yaml/semantic chunkers, tokenizer-based sizing, and the standalone `chunk` command.
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: xberg-chunking
  metadata:
    name: xberg-chunking

type: Playbook
title: Extracting Keywords
description: Use when extracting keywords (YAKE/RAKE) from documents — and, secondarily, when detecting document language or generating embeddings for RAG and search. Covers the keyword config (and its feature gating), `--detect-language`, and the standalone `embed` command with real flags.
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: xberg-extracting-keywords
  metadata:
    name: xberg-extracting-keywords

type: Playbook
title: Extracting Tables
description: Use when extracting tabular data from PDFs, spreadsheets, or images. Covers layout-aware table detection, table model selection, output formats (markdown / JSON cells), and known limits.
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: xberg-extracting-tables
  metadata:
    name: xberg-extracting-tables

type: Playbook
title: Extracting With Ocr
description: Use when extracting text from scanned PDFs, photographed pages, or images that have no embedded text layer. Covers OCR backends, language packs, force-OCR, and performance tuning.
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: xberg-extracting-with-ocr
  metadata:
    name: xberg-extracting-with-ocr

type: Playbook
title: Picking A Format
description: Use when choosing an output format for extracted documents — plain text, markdown, djot, HTML, JSON, or DocTags. Maps consumer (LLM, parser, archive) to the right `--format` / `--content-format` pair.
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: xberg-picking-a-format
  metadata:
    name: xberg-picking-a-format

type: Playbook
title: Xberg
description: Extract text, tables, metadata, and images from 107 document formats (PDF, Office, images, HTML, email, archives, academic) using Xberg. Use when writing code that calls Xberg APIs in Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Rust, or CLI. Covers installation, extraction (sync/async), configuration (OCR, chunking, output format), batch processing, error handling, and plugins.
x-ai-rulez:
  kind: skill
  id: xberg
  metadata:
    license: Elastic-2.0
    metadata:
      author: xberg-io
      version: "0.1.0"
      repository: https://github.com/xberg-io/xberg
    name: xberg
